en: Know what? I'm here because Professor Juniper asked me to be. I'm researching a Pokémon called Tynamo!
There aren't very many of them, and they don't look very strong... They must get stronger when they evolve. I'll find out how!
Hi! I'm the Nugget man. Glad you showed up! I'd like you to have this.
That's a Nugget! How did it get so golden without being deep-fried? That's a trade secret!
Nuggetaboutit! Come back whenever you like.
And I'm the Nugget boy! Here, I want you to have one, too.
Nuggets sell for a lot, but I'd keep it. Shiny things bring good luck!
Dad says nothing beats a nugget in the hand.
